{{Quote|That's the ''shatual'', by the way, roasted and sliced. Share it with Darman and the boys. Right way to celebrate the birth of a son.|[[Rav Bralor]] to [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
'''Roast ''shatual''''' was a meal enjoyed by numerous members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. Prepared from the meat of a ''[[shatual]]''—a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal native<ref name="TC" /> to the [[veshok]]-[[Tree/Legends|tree]] forests of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> the Mandalorians' cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>—the creature would first be butchered, and its meat then roasted over an open [[Fire/Legends|flame]] until cooked to satisfaction. The roasted ''shatual'' meat was then sliced and served.<ref name="TC" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Strill/Legends|strill]] known as [[Lord Mirdalan]] hunted and [[Death/Legends|killed]] a ''shatual'', returning with its prize to its [[Walon Vau|master]] and friends within [[Clan Skirata]] at their home of [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]] on Mandalore. There, family friend [[Rav Bralor]] butchered the catch and roasted the ''shatual'' meat over an open fire, and the extended clan dined on the resulting meal that evening. Shortly after, slices of leftover roast ''shatual'' were wrapped up to be taken by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] back to the [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] known as [[Omega Squad]], her lover [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] among them.<ref name="TC" />

Later in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], more roast ''shatual'' was prepared at the Skirata home, and several members of the clan enjoyed slices of the fire-roasted meat at their leisure.<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Roast ''shatual'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2007]] novel, ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', the third entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
